name: Letter Intent 1
definition: Specifies information about the letter of intent.

LetterIntentReference.name: Letter Intent Reference
LetterIntentReference.definition: Reference of a letter of intent program, in which sales commissions are reduced based on the aggregate of a customer's actual purchase and anticipated purchases, over a specific period of time, and as agreed by the customer.

Amount.name: Amount
Amount.definition: Amount stated on the letter of intent.

StartDate.name: Start Date
StartDate.definition: Start date stated on the letter of intent.

EndDate.name: End Date
EndDate.definition: End date stated on the letter of intent.
